1. Extend the image with the border mode by half its size, at most 256 pixels, on each side.
2. Take the 2D FFT of the image and of the PSF placed at the grid origin.
3. Find gamma by bisection so the residual matches sigma^2.
4. Multiply each frequency by conj(H) / (|H|^2 + gamma |P|^2).
5. Take the inverse FFT, keep the real part and crop the extension.
